description: Plan a safe rebase before you start: count merge commits and squash-merge markers in the branch history, weigh the upstream distance and whether the branch is published, and return a strategy, steps, and warnings.

commits.description: The branch's own commits, oldest first: {hash, subject, merge}

merge.description: True when the commit is a merge commit (optional, default false)

published.description: Whether the branch has been pushed or shared (optional)

upstream_commits.description: Commits the upstream branch has that this branch does not (optional): {hash, subject}

name: plan_rebase
